name: Manifest permissions request authority but do not grant it

applicability.reason: Supported. C008 makes manifest `permissions` entries REQUESTS that only the Host grants, and the host-side `iris.grants` boundary already exists beside the manifest, which is what this row was held on. All three halves are covered by their own fixture: an ungranted REQUIRED request prevents the package load with PermissionDenied, which this row observes; an ungranted OPTIONAL request loads but grants no authority, answering ReflectionAccessError; and an UNSPECIFIED permission defaults deny the same way, measured against fixtures/meta/v909-optional-ungranted and fixtures/meta/v909-unspecified.
